items.title: Dozens more children killed in Yemen amid escalating hostilities
items.summary: The UN child rights agency, UNICEF, on Wednesday called for warring parties in Yemen to protect children as renewed conflict between Houthi rebels and Government forces approaches the three-month mark.

items.title: Ukraine: Civilian casualties in 2026 already far exceed previous years’ tolls
items.summary: This year has seen dramatically higher civilian casualties in Ukraine than any other year since the full-scale invasion of the eastern European country by Russia in February 2022, the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine (HRMMU) said on Tuesday.

items.title: World News in Brief: Ebola cases double in DR Congo, chemical exposure starts before birth, Türk concern over EU-Rwanda transfer plan
items.summary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has more than doubled in three months, with more than 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths now reported in 67 health zones across eight provinces, the head of the World Health Organization (WHO) said on Tuesday.

items.title: Haiti: ‘Atrocious abuses’ continue as UN warns anti-gang operations must priortise civilian protection
items.summary: The UN human rights office, OHCHR has urged greater protection for civilians in Haiti amid ongoing “atrocious abuses” committed by gangs and intensified security operations.

items.title: ‘Hunger should not be a concern’: WFP steps in for families in Kenya who fled Ethiopia violence
items.summary: The World Food Programme (WFP) is assisting thousands of families who fled recent violence in Ethiopia for the Moyale area in neighbouring Kenya, the UN agency reported on Tuesday.
